items.title: Buffout
items.fact: Buffout is a consumable performance-enhancing drug that boosts both Strength and Endurance, in addition to a health increase of 60 HP.

items.title: Bottle cap
items.fact: The bottle cap is the main currency used in the Mojave Wasteland when dealing with NPCs.

items.title: Quantum X-01 power armor
items.fact: Quantum X-01 power armor is a custom set of X-01 power armor appearing in the Fallout 4 add-on Nuka-World.

items.title: Sheriff's duster
items.fact: The sheriff's duster and sheriff's hat are pieces of clothing.

items.title: Brotherhood soldier suit
items.fact: The Brotherhood soldier suit allows armor pieces to be worn over it.

items.title: Radstag
items.fact: Most radstags will flee on instinct when the player character or a predator approaches too close or attacks.

items.title: Sheepsquatch
items.fact:
Sheepsquatches are creatures found in Appalachia. ## Background
A cryptid stalking the Appalachian mountains, the Sheepsquatch myth was an obsession for many cryptid hunters…

items.title: Big Book of Science
items.fact: Reading this book permanently increases the player character's Science skill by 3 points (4 with the Comprehension perk).

items.title: Mister Orderly
items.fact: Mister Orderly is a medical robot model created by General Atomics International. It is a medical version of the GAI/RobCo model Mister Handy.

items.title: Leather coat
items.fact: The leather coat and traveling leather coat are outfits in Fallout 76.

items.title: Minigun
items.fact: It requires a moment to spin up before it actually starts firing, but makes up for the delay with a high rate of fire and large ammunition capacity.

items.title: Nuka T-51 power armor
items.fact: This is a suit of T-51 power armor branded with Nuka-Cola Corporation logos and colors, put on display in the World of Refreshment boat tour ride at Nuka-World.

items.title: Bloatfly
items.fact: Bloatflies are mutated insects living in the Mojave Wasteland, Zion Canyon, and Big MT in 2281.

items.title: Ballistic weave
items.fact: Ballistic weave is an armor mod in Fallout 4 that allows for adding improved defensive stats to certain clothing items, including outfits, underarmor, and a small number of hats.

items.title: Joshua Graham's armor
items.fact: Joshua Graham's armor is a set of armor in the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Honest Hearts.

items.title: Naughty nightwear
items.fact: When equipped, the outfit does not grant any Damage Threshold but does grant +10 Speech and +1 Luck.

items.title: The AntAgonizer's costume
items.fact: The AntAgonizer's costume and the matching The AntAgonizer's helmet are worn by the AntAgonizer, who is one of the two superheroes fighting in Canterbury Commons in the Capital Wasteland.

items.title: Pint-Sized Slasher mask
items.fact: It is a colorful clown's mask with a spotted hat on top, specially made to be wearable by children, while also striking fear into the hearts of victims.

items.title: Mega sloth
items.fact: Mega sloths, also known as megasloths, are creatures found in Appalachia.

items.title: Motor-Runner's helmet
items.fact: It grants a +5 bonus to Melee Weapons and a +1 bonus to Perception.

items.title: Cram
items.fact: Cram restores 5 Hit Points but also gives a small amount of radiation in the form of 3 rads.

items.title: Pitt raiders
items.fact: The Pitt raiders, also known as Ashur's army, are a group of slavers who rule over the Pitt slaves in the Pitt after the Scourge.

items.title: Atom Cats
items.fact: The Atom Cats are a minor faction that draws inspiration from mid-1950s greasers, with leather outfits and a hotrod-themed paint job for their power armor.

items.title: Giant ant
items.fact: Giant ants are mutated insects found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Wood
items.fact: Moe Cronin in Diamond City sells shipments of 100 units of wood.

items.title: Sugar Bombs
items.fact: A pack of sugary cereal that holds 100% of the recommended daily amount of sugar, Sugar Bombs have been preserved for 25 years after the Great War.

items.title: Regulators
items.fact: The Regulators are a faction encountered in the Capital Wasteland.

items.title: Plasma gun
items.fact: The plasma gun is a versatile urban warfare weapon that can be used as a pistol, sniper rifle, semi-auto rifle, assault rifle, shotgun or even a flamethrower…

items.title: Buffout
items.fact: The addiction effects are -1 Strength and -1 Endurance once Buffout has worn off.

items.title: Blue Devil
items.fact: The Blue Devil is a type of creature and cryptid found in Appalachia.

items.title: Acid
items.fact: Acid is an uncommon component that is primarily used in chemistry stations for smelting ore and crafting unrefined gunpowder.

items.title: Lyons' Pride
items.fact: Lyons' Pride (commonly truncated as the Pride) is a special tactical unit within Lyons' Brotherhood of Steel, composed of elite Brotherhood soldiers led by Sentinel Sarah Lyons in 2277.

items.title: Doctor's bag
items.fact: A leather bag containing the tools used by a physician to heal crippled limbs, serving this purpose in both normal and hardcore modes.

items.title: REPCONN Aerospace
items.fact: Their headquarters and test site can still be found in the Mojave Wasteland.

items.title: Raiders
items.fact: Raiders are a type of faction, comprising multiple decentralized groups of nomadic bandits, outlaws, and thugs that occupy various locations throughout the Commonwealth.

items.title: T-60 power armor
items.fact: The T-60 power armor provides good radiation protection, stronger than the T-45, T-51 and Ultracite, but weaker than the X-01 and T-65.

items.title: Minigun
items.fact: The minigun delivers an extremely high rate of fire, making it ideal for inflicting heavy damage on large quantities of relatively unarmored enemies.

items.title: Robobrain
items.fact: Robobrains can then be encountered in the Commonwealth and on the Island in 2287, respectively.

items.title: Night stalker
items.fact: Night stalkers are a genetic hybridization of the coyote and rattlesnake, displaying characteristics of both.

items.title: Overseer's Guardian
items.fact: This weapon comes guaranteed with the Two Shot effect, which shoots an additional projectile with each shot.

items.title: Spoiled vegetables
items.fact: A more practical use for the spoiled vegetable is to convert it into raw fertilizer at a chemistry station, at a rate of 10 spoiled vegetables for one raw fertilizer.

items.title: Power fist
items.fact: However, like the previous designs, the power fist also uses a pneumatic battering ram to deliver powerful, medium-speed punches to attackers, releasing a puff of steam and sparks with each punch.

items.title: Vault jumpsuit
items.fact: It is worn under armor and apparel and can be modded to increase Damage Resistance, Energy Resistance and Radiation Resistance.

items.title: Steel ingot
items.fact: High grade ingots made of industrial-strength steel that were forged before the Great War in the mills located in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

items.title: Mister Gutsy
items.fact: The Mister Gutsy is a variant of robot found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. It is the military model of the much more common civilian Mister Handy model.

items.title: Double-barrel shotgun
items.fact: Commonly found on low level raiders, Minutemen soldiers and rarely settlers.

items.title: Westside Cooperative
items.fact: The Westside Cooperative is a farming commune and leadership council operating within the community of Westside in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Vault jumpsuit
items.fact: All jumpsuits with the exception of those from Vault 11 have no Damage Threshold, but provide a bonus of +2 to Speech and Melee Weapons and can be repaired with other Vault jumpsuits.

items.title: Softshell mirelurk meat
items.fact: It can restore up to 30 Hit Points (36 HP with food sanitizer in the inventory), but also causes minor radiation poisoning (2 rads).

items.title: Diehards
items.fact: In Wastelanders, they returned under the leadership of Meg Groberg.

items.title: Kings
items.fact: Taking the King's School of Impersonation as their headquarters, the Kings subsequently claimed the surrounding area of Freeside as their territory.

items.title: Purified water
items.fact: Purified water is water that is completely free of radiation, and as such can be safely consumed without harming the player.

items.title: Gauss rifle
items.fact: The Gauss rifle is able to deliver very high damage after being fired when fully charged.

items.title: Gecko
items.fact: Geckos can be found living across the entire Mojave Wasteland, with many different species calling the local area their breeding grounds.

items.title: Angler
items.fact: Anglers' energy resistance is much higher than their damage resistance, making ballistic or melee weapons the preferable choice for engaging them in combat.

items.title: Fission battery
items.fact: Three fission batteries and four conductors can be used to reprogram Primm Slim to be the sheriff of Primm (if one's Science is lower than 30).

items.title: Tunnel Snake outfit
items.fact: It is a leather jacket with a snake emblem on the back, worn on top of a Vault 101 jumpsuit.

items.title: Scoped .44 Magnum
items.fact: The scoped.44 Magnum is a very high-powered pistol. It has a very long effective range, which is further extended by the scope but also has a low rate of fire for a double-action revolver.

items.title: D.C. Journal of Internal Medicine
items.fact: The D.C. Journal of Internal Medicine is a skill book in Fallout 3.

items.title: Lesser Devil
items.fact: Lesser Devils are creatures found in Atlantic City. They are offspring of the Jersey Devil, a separate creature type and cryptid.

items.title: Diamond City security
items.fact: Diamond City security is the main security force of Diamond City in 2287.

items.title: Radscorpion
items.fact: Radscorpions are mutated from the North American Emperor scorpion, which were prolific in many pet stores at the time of the Great War.

items.title: Pre-War money
items.fact: Pre-War money appears as a stack of indistinguishable bills.

items.title: Gauss rifle
items.fact: The Gauss rifle is an advanced sniper rifle included in the Fallout 3 add-on Operation: Anchorage.

items.title: The Ghoul's coat
items.fact: It provides wearers with +2 Perception, +2 Endurance, +2 Charisma, and +2 Agility.

items.title: Christine's CoS recon armor
items.fact: A unique set of recon armor used by The Circle (CoS), that was worn by Christine Royce when she was hunting Elijah.

items.title: Regulators
items.fact: In 2158, Jon Zimmerman hired mercenaries that displaced the original Regulators.

items.title: Leather
items.fact: It is a common component primarily used for crafting armor and its modifications.

items.title: Chainsaw
items.fact: A fully automatic melee weapon with sharp teeth able to shred virtually anything they come into contact with.

items.title: Laser rifle
items.fact: The laser rifle has no iron sights but compensates with excellent zoom.

items.title: Wasteland Survival Guide
items.fact: Reading this book permanently increases the Courier's Survival skill by 3 points (4 with the Comprehension perk).

items.title: State of Utobitha
items.fact: The State of Utobitha is a remnant group of first and second generation super mutants led by Tabitha in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Marine armor
items.fact: An advanced model of combat armor worn by U.S. Marines at the Mount Desert Island Naval Facility, second only to power armor in protection.

items.title: Coyote
items.fact: Coyotes are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Baseball bat
items.fact: This is a long, smooth wooden bat, typically made of ash, for use in the sport of baseball.

items.title: Anti-materiel rifle
items.fact: The anti-materiel rifle is a left-handed, bolt-action rifle that uses.50 caliber rounds.

items.title: Survivalist's rifle
items.fact: It once belonged to Randall Clark, a former U.S. soldier and survivalist who took refuge in Zion National Park after the Great War…

items.title: Flamer
items.fact: The flamer is a short range heavy weapon that deals sustained fire damage in a cone in front of it.

items.title: Lying, Congressional Style
items.fact: Reading this book permanently increases the Lone Wanderer's Speech skill by 1 (2 with Comprehension).

items.title: Raider leathers
items.fact:
Raider leathers is an underarmor in Fallout 76. ## Characteristics
A makeshift undergarment stitched by raiders from strips of fabric and leather.

items.title: Raul's Petro-Chico jumpsuit
items.fact: This jumpsuit has a dark green color, with white lines on its sleeves and a Petró-Chico patch sewn on the left breast and a name patch on the right that says "Miguel".

items.title: Armored vault suit
items.fact: It is a direct upgrade as it enhances a dwellers Perception by +3.

items.title: Kings outfit
items.fact: Both the male and female version of the Kings outfit consist of a zipped-up, black leather jacket with an upturned collar over a white t-shirt, paired with dirtied blue jeans and black boots.

items.title: Super sledge
items.fact: A two-handed blunt melee weapon resembling a massive metallic hammer with a padded handle that contains a kinetic energy storage device to increase the knockback effect of the weapon.

items.title: Nukashine
items.fact: Nukashine is a consumable item in Fallout 76, introduced in the Wild Appalachia update.

items.title: Tumblers Today
items.fact: Tumblers Today is a book containing information about the art of locksmithing or rather information of the latest in mechanical locks found in safes, footlockers, and doors.

items.title: Mechanist's armor
items.fact: The armor provides a Damage Resistance of 72 as well as an Energy Resistance 72, increases the Sole Survivor's Endurance by 1 and also reduces the damage the player character takes from robots by 15%.

items.title: Hazmat suit
items.fact: The experimental hazmat suit and hazmat darklight cowl were created at Big MT before the Great War.

items.title: Vault-Tec security armor
items.fact: This armor set was issued by the Vault-Tec Corporation, in small quantities, to the security personnel of each Vault-Tec Vault.

items.title: Water Merchants
items.fact: The Water Merchants are a major caravan company operating out of the Hub in New California in 2161.
